steps.caption: Option 1B · Project rail. Pick a project; the whole sidebar follows it.
Hover a project: its name, its key, and what needs you.
Scoped: Overview and Chat, this project's Recent, its types with counts.
Type views filter to the project, with a chip you can remove.
⌘3 switches to Home office: only its pages, and its own panes.
⌘1 is All: the sidebar as it is today.
